title: ask run start pwsh path resolution
desc: RunStart in AskCommands.RunRegistry.cs resolves pwsh/powershell to full path before Process.Start to survive parallel-worker stripped-PATH environments
steps: 1. ResolvePwshExe(name) in ChatCommand.Resolvers.cs probes well-known PowerShell 7 install paths (Program Files, LocalAppData), falls back to Windows PowerShell 5 (System32 WindowsPowerShell v1.0), then PATH walk.
2. RunStart calls ResolvePwshExe when cmdArgv[0] is pwsh/pwsh.exe/powershell/powershell.exe after IsExternalExe branch selects exe = cmdArgv[0].

3. Bug: parallel workers (RunParallelWithFlushAsync -> RunGeminiLoopAsync -> AskGemini) failed with 'An error occurred trying to start process pwsh ... file not found' because PATH was empty/stripped.
4. Verified 2026-05-15: suggest 2026-05-14T11:07:40 resolved at commit c1fe24743.
